meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求生成时间线报告时,Claude 会从 claude-mem 获取项目的完整时间线数据,并产出一份名为『Journey Into [项目名]』的长篇叙事报告,涵盖项目起源、架构演变、关键突破、技术债务等历史分析。
howto.when: 当用户要求写时间线报告、分析项目历史或生成完整项目报告等时触发;需 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目有记录。

say.note: 生成 Journey Into [项目名] 报告

say.text: 分析这个项目的开发历史
say.note: 会获取并分析完整时间线
等同于要求完整项目报告

howto.what_en: Claude turns claude-mem's full project timeline into a narrative 'Journey Into [Project]' report covering origins, architecture, breakthroughs, work patterns, tech debt, challenges, memory continuity, ROI math, stats, and lessons.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, or a full project report; requires the claude-mem worker running and recorded observations for the project.

say_en.note: Fetches and analyzes the full timeline
Same as a full project report
